o.text: From Turkish paylaşım. By surface analysis, paylaş- + -ım.
From Turkic, from Proto-Common Turkic *tasma (“leash, strap”). Cognate with Kumyk тасма (tasma), Bashkir таҫма (taśma).
From Classical Persian مِنَّتْدَار (minnatdār). By surface analysis, minnət + -dar. Compare Tajik миннатдорӣ (minnatdori).
Izafet II compound of qonaq (“guest”) + otaq (“room”). Calque of Russian гости́ная (gostínaja).
